name: Debt Collection Summary
query:
SELECT
  dp.customer AS `Customer`,
  SUM(dp.amount) AS `Total Collected`,
  MIN(dp.dated) AS `First Payment`,
  MAX(dp.dated) AS `Last Payment`,
  COUNT(dp.name) AS `Payments`
FROM `tabDebt Payment` dp
WHERE dp.docstatus = 1
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR dp.dated >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR dp.dated <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(customer)s IS NULL OR %(customer)s = '' OR dp.customer = %(customer)s)
GROUP BY dp.customer
ORDER BY SUM(dp.amount) DESC
